# Clyvora Lens

> Clyvora Lens is Clyvora's free, source-available, local-first workbench for inspecting, searching, filtering, and converting JSON and CSV files.

Clyvora Lens runs in the browser. Selected file contents are processed on the user's device and are not uploaded to a backend. The app has no account system, analytics, cloud storage, advertising, external API, or AI integration.

## Capabilities

- Inspect JSON as a tree or formatted text.
- Search JSON keys and values and copy paths or subtrees.
- Search, filter, and sort CSV data.
- Convert JSON to CSV and CSV to JSON with configurable output options.
- Process large files off the main browser thread.

## Official links
